warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; not live authorization, persistent runtime attestation, financial safety, backing, liquidity, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, pauses, policies and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory.

Ethereum direct nonproxy VaultFactory 0xe67193ca18132e1ccb59ee745b388cecce37cc4c only. Source record grades creation/runtime match, not exact_match. Observed vaultDeployer=0x637e8b8d56164dc83c93b62dd17efb1493936a60 and paymentModule=0x28dc7cea1a442bddbce26ca641b5d60f0a003efd are mutable factory-admin dependencies; complete full-source snapshots retained without claiming dependency safety.

createVaultWithoutKey creates an actual term custody/vesting ledger and funds its newly deployed fixed vault. No VaultKey NFT is minted. Caller chooses beneficiary and unlock timestamp; beneficiary, not depositor, owns resulting withdrawal rights. No role, approval, transfer-helper, key mint, ownership-change, arbitrary target/calldata or backend signing capability is added.

The full deployed mixed-asset ABI is admitted honestly: fungible token/LP, NFT and ERC1155 deposit arrays are supported for batch locks; isVesting=true requires NFT and ERC1155 arrays empty and linearly vests fungible assets only. No runtime ERC20-only argument restriction is claimed. Tokens use their native base units; NFT ids are not fungible amounts.

Unlock timestamp must be at least block.timestamp, one or more deposits required, each fungible/multitoken amount positive, and combined deposit-entry count strictly below mutable maxTokensPerVault. Existing whitelist eligibility applies if enabled; point-in-time whitelistEnabled=false is not an ongoing grant. Referrer must differ from caller and beneficiary.

PaymentModule pulls only params.user=msg.sender approved assets. Fungible custody is actual received balance delta minus configured LP fee, so gross requested amount is not guaranteed net locked amount. V3 LP NFT fees can reduce liquidity using zero amount0Min/amount1Min before custody. Configured pricing/LP-processing/router/oracle dependencies and fees are mutable; this function has no user minimum net locked amount or explicit fee cap.

Payable native value is fee funding, not native principal custody. With zero native value, configured USD fee is pulled from caller using existing approval; with native value it can be swapped to cover USD fees or split directly per configuration, and leftover value is refunded to caller. Fixed protocol fee/referral flows are not caller-supplied arbitrary execution.

Nonvesting assets remain locked until the chosen timestamp; fungible vesting releases pro-rata remaining balance with floor rounding and all remaining after end. Without key, initial beneficiary controls release; a beneficiary could separately mint a key through excluded deployment methods, changing control to key ownership. No dynamic newly created vault addresses or their release/extend/key methods are admitted here, so creation is not a complete unlocking workflow. Term custody does not promise yield, token value or permanent LP liquidity.
